summary.text: A single-member thread on generational politics, thin on evidence: two posts nine days apart, no colleague echo. On August 30, @RepMaxwellFrost promoted his appearance on @JubileeMedia's "Surrounded," debating the generational gap and arguing it is smaller than most Americans assume; that post drew one member retweet, the only amplification so far. On September 8 he returned alone with a sharper line: Boomers were once the "Me Generation" and now call Gen Z lazy. The framing moved from bridging to rebuttal, turning the criticism back on older generations. Open: whether anyone joins him, whether it attaches to a policy fight, and whether it outlasts the clip.
